note: THE LAYER CELLS, AS DATA. A record is a CONSTRUCTOR and a SEED: `build()` is deterministic from it, and a document cites a cell BY NAME and never by a description of its density. Two numbers carrying the same cell name are commensurable; two carrying different names are not. A STATISTIC IS NOT A FIXTURE -- the realized statistics live in layer_manifest.json, which is checked against these constructors, never a substitute for them.

fields.name: the cell's identity; documents and ledger rows cite it, so a name is never reused or renamed
fields.widths: the routing topology's per-level digit counts
fields.tokens: T, the prefill length in tokens
fields.hidden: the producer's hidden size; 0 means H * dv
fields.alpha: null selects dense (softmax) routing; a float selects the entmax union routing at that alpha
fields.logit_gain: the producer's routing projection is scaled by this before any input is drawn -- the density knob
fields.dtype: bf16 | fp32, the module and operand dtype
fields.seed: parameters from manual_seed(seed); inputs from a device generator at seed + 500
fields.decode_steps: single-token steps taken after the prefill; 0 is a prefill-only cell
fields.note: what this cell is FOR, in the words the registry is read with

cells.name: chunk-p73-pinned

cells.name: chunk-sparse-gain8
